reason: I buy in quantity to resell, and 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% kills my margin on every piece. The agent I already use moves my cargo cheaper, and I know him.
objection: Paying the item and fee up front to a new page I've never dealt with. My cousin lost a deposit to a page that disappeared, and I can't afford to lose shop money.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk rate for big orders (lower per-kilo or cheaper sea/cargo option) and being able to pay at a real office I can visit, after a small test order arrives on time.
